props.name: letters
props.description: The letters on the bar, in order. Defaults to A–Z; pass your own for other alphabets or a leading "#".

props.name: available
props.description: Letters that have entries. The rest are shown but disabled. Omit to enable every letter.

props.name: targetIdPrefix
props.description: Where each letter’s group heading is: the element with id `${targetIdPrefix}${letter}`. The heading receives focus, so give it `tabIndex={-1}` (it is added if missing).

props.name: getTarget
props.description: Finds the heading for a letter, instead of the id convention.

props.name: onJump
props.description: Called after a jump, with the letter.

props.name: current
props.description: The letter to mark as current — for example the group scrolled into view.

props.name: orientation
props.description: vertical is the rail beside a contact list; horizontal sits above a directory.

props.name: scrub
props.description: Let touch and pen users scrub along the bar to jump as they drag.
